title: Market entry signal grid and success metrics
body:
Purpose:
This working sheet collects the launch/market-entry signals we will treat as the canonical single source of truth for go/no-go decisions, escalations, and early remediation. It prioritizes observable customer-facing signals (usage, latency, errors, quality) and internal ops signals (capacity, cost, QA coverage). The aim is to keep the checklist compact enough to make quick calls and rich enough to surface triage owners and remediation steps.

How to use this doc (quick):
- Use the Signal Grid (table below) during release readiness calls. Mark color and small note each day of rollout.
- Owners update metric trends and link dashboards or queries for the ‘source of truth’.
- If any red gate trips, escalate to on-call SRE + eng PM; amber triggers watch-and-hold with mitigation plan.

High-level rollout phases (context):
- Alpha (internal): limited seats, manual verification
- Beta (invite-only): small external cohort (~100 orgs, 1000 DAUs)
- Ramp (progressive ramp): 10% -> 50% -> 100% routing over 2–6 days depending on signals

Signal Grid (canonical):
Columns: Signal | Why it matters | Source dashboard / query | Collection cadence | Green condition | Amber condition | Red condition | Owner | Escalation action
1) Client success activation | First 7-day product activation rate for invited orgs | Dashboard: /dashboards/activation-7d | daily | >= 40% | 20–39% | <20% | Marisol G. | Hold ramp, contact cohort, surface UX bug list
2) Inference latency (p95 user-facing) | UX snappiness, SLA target for hosted | Query: metrics.api.latency.p95?env=beta | 15m | <= 200 ms | 200–400 ms | >400 ms | Evan C. | Re-route to lower-capacity variant / enable extra pool; notify infra
3) Tail latency (99.9th) | User-impacting spikes | Dashboard: tail-latency-overview | 15m | <= 1s | 1–3s | >3s | SRE on-call (rota) | Pause ramp; kick full profiler trace; attach kernel dump if on-prem
4) Error rate (4xx+5xx / total requests) | Correctness and regressions | Query: errors/total?service=inference | 15m | <= 0.5% | 0.5–2% | >2% | Jonah R. | Rollback recent model/route; enable fallback to stable-model; open incident
5) Model output quality (regression score) | Business-level quality measured by eval suite | Artifact: evals/market-entry-set-1 | daily | >= 0.9 pass rate | 0.8–0.89 | <0.8 | Asha P. | Pause canary; revert to earlier model; escalate to applied-ml
6) Cost per 1k tokens (in progress) | Cost controls: unit economics while ramping | Query: billing.unit_costs?period=24h | daily | <= $0.50 | $0.51–1.00 | >$1.00 | Finance lead (TBD) | Enable batching suggestions; switch to quantized instance; review autoscale
7) KV cache hit rate (hot-prefixes) | Batching/caching efficiency | Dashboard: cache-hits | 1h | >= 70% | 40–69% | <40% | Runtime eng | Lower cold starts; investigate cache warming scripts
8) Support volume per 1k users (tickets) | Customer friction signal | Query: zendesk.tickets?tag=market-entry | daily | <= 5 | 6–15 | >15 | CS lead | Open bug Triage, increase CS coverage, delay ramp
9) Security/Compliance findings (critical) | Must be zero for go-wide | Reports: security-scan/latest | on-change | 0 critical | 1 non-critical | >=1 critical | Security PM | Block rollout until fix validated; run full regression scan

Gate matrix (what tripping means):
- Green: proceed cadence; record in rollout log.
- Amber: slow ramp for 24–48h; apply mitigations; re-check; owner must provide written mitigation and ETA in the rollout channel.
- Red: immediate pause of next ramp step, incident call if safety/security or customer-impacting; prepare rollback plan.

Operational play snippets (quick mitigation cookbook):
- Latency spike (p95 amber->red): 1) pause ramp; 2) switch to lower-capacity/quantized variant for new requests; 3) roll SLO-based throttling for heavy customers; 4) run stack profiler and share to infra channel.
- Quality regression: 1) run local evals on last-pass prompt suite; 2) revert to pinned model; 3) open PR to revert config; 4) notify customers on beta list.
- Cost overshoot: 1) enable batching and caching policy from Optimize suggestions; 2) move non-critical jobs to dedicated off-peak window; 3) restrict max token limit on invites.

Rollout schedule template (example):
Day 0: Alpha done; internal checklist green
Day 1: Beta open to 100 orgs (10% of invite list) -> monitor signals 6x/day
Day 2: Expand to 500 orgs -> monitor 4x/day; if all green expand to ramp stage
Day 3-5: Ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% across 3 steps, 12–24h between steps depending on signal health

Acceptance SLOs (required for go-wide):
- Production p95 latency <= 250ms for hosted API across 95% regions
- Error rate <= 0.5% steady-state for 24h at 50% load
- Eval pass rate >= 0.9 on newly onboarded prompt set
- No critical security findings

Dashboards and owners (source-of-truth links):
- Activation & engagement: /dashboards/activation-7d (owner: Marisol)
- Latency & tail: /dashboards/latency-suite (owner: Evan)
- Errors & logs: /dashboards/errors (owner: Jonah)
- Cost & billing: /dashboards/unit-costs (owner: FinanceOps)
- Evals: /dashboards/evals/market-entry (owner: Asha)

Open questions / TODOs:
- Assign final FinanceOps owner for cost gate (ticket: PRODOPS-701)
- Add customer-specific throttles for top 10% heavy users (design doc link in linked_artifacts)
- Finalize CS on-call overlap for beta weekend (Marisol to confirm)

Notes on documentation hygiene:
- Every time a gate is marked amber/red the owner must append a 2–3 line note to the rollout log (timestamped) and link the supporting dashboard snapshot.
- If a rollback happens, produce a rollback write-up with timeline, impact, and root cause hypothesis; post to confluence fragment (see linked_artifacts).

Appendix: Quick checklist for go-wide decision meeting:
- All critical signals green for 48h at 50% ramp? (Y/N)
- No open critical security findings? (Y/N)
- Finance sign-off on unit economics or committed mitigation? (Y/N)
- CS head confirmed support readiness? (Y/N)
- Eng lead + SRE on-call present for first 24h after go-wide? (Y/N)

History & versions:
- v0.1 (2025-09-12) initial draft, alpha signals
- v0.3 (2025-09-20) added cost gate and tail-latency thresholds after SRE review
- v0.5 (2025-10-03) tightened eval thresholds and added escalation cookbook (current)
